selected_branches.branch: Intersection proximity during destination stopping or standing

law_text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within fifteen feet of an intersection.

comparisons.interpretation: 14/15/16 ft are requested numeric probes; observed original body geometry and measurement uncertainty decide the relation. Fifteen feet is statutory, not an engineering safety threshold.

deliberate_differences: destination halt activity and dwell protocol
observed traffic conflict and necessity context or applicable police/device direction
comparisons.interpretation: These cases retain the exception alternatives for source review; no traffic condition or command alone proves legal necessity.

observations.name: original_body_to_intersection_gap
observations.source: original Native body pose, body dimensions, and source-bound intersection geometry
observations.measurement: minimum footprint-to-boundary distance across approach and halt; full raw history retained
observations.uncertainty: Map boundary definition and body dimensions must be reviewed; frame sampling may miss a transient.

observations.name: halt_activity
observations.source: original Native velocity/position/controller state plus camera frames
observations.measurement: approach, halt onset, dwell and departure; distinguish stop and stand context
observations.uncertainty: An observed halt does not reveal purpose.

observations.name: exception_context
observations.source: original traffic tracks, governing device/police directions, authored context packet
observations.measurement: direction state, conflict trajectories, compliance context and time of halt
observations.uncertainty: Necessity is unresolved judgment; purpose cannot be derived solely from a requested controller action.

runtime_uncertainties: Physical map boundary, realized approach and halt, and camera coverage require later CARLA review.

Geometry targets are CPU tested; exact map binding, runner/controller, Native capture, case-specific finalizer, semantic proposals, compatibility, saved-only processing, delivery and comparison audits remain CPU work.
The frozen cell maneuver stop_stand does not itself establish a parking maneuver; park alternative requires independent binding review before claiming complete statutory coverage.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed every frozen evidence inventory entry and its local accepted metadata; compared case identities and acceptance fields only. Physical equivalence and branch coverage remain unresolved.

gaps.requirement: Source-bound original episode for intersection distance, destination halt and exception context
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: Frozen evidence inventory lists zero accepted recordings.

witness_review.branch: Intersection proximity during destination stopping or standing
required_context: Establish a supported approach and each participant's destination relative to the intersection boundary; participants need not occupy the same road segment.
Establish jurisdiction, qualifying vehicle, responsible person and the unresolved applicability of the NRS definitions.
Establish jurisdiction, vehicle scope, responsible person, service activity, traffic circumstances and applicable directions.
Realize a supported approach and destination relative to a qualifying intersection; participants need not occupy the same road segment.
Record actual service activity, other traffic and applicable laws or directions; preserve the exception wording and unresolved necessity standard.
Retain vehicle extent and intersection geometry throughout the destination halt.
Retain vehicle extent, motion and intersection geometry through halt onset and end without imposing a fifteen-foot measurement convention.
witness_review.reason: A destination halt can occur near the intersection without changing the task into compelled safety stopping.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: No person shall stop or stand a vehicle
Within fifteen feet of an intersection
Except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law
Or the directions of a police officer
Or the directions of a traffic control device
